questions.q: Which of the following economic groupings was established primarily to promote economic integration and free trade across West Africa?
options: Economic Community of West African States
questions.explain: The **Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)** was established in 1975 with the primary objective of fostering economic integration, cooperation, and free trade among West African countries.
questions.exam: NECO Commerce Part 2: Finance, Marketing, Legal Aspects & Business Management

questions.q: All of the following are core objectives of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) EXCEPT:
options: promoting the free movement of people, goods, and services
working towards establishing a common regional currency
eliminating customs duties and quantitative restrictions among member states
forming a joint military alliance to colonize neighboring Central African countries
questions.explain: ECOWAS is an *economic* grouping focused on integration, free trade (eliminating tariffs), and eventual monetary union. It is **not** an expansionist military alliance aimed at colonizing or conquering other regions.
